about: Item stand counts in the vanilla corpus builds (lab/mine_stands.js, 1,559 vanilla builds, 346 with stands inside) under four settings of VH_SHAPES: colliders (unset; the committed data/stands-corpus.json, identical on main 509744e and on ee15184), oldcoarse (main 509744e lib and data, VH_SHAPES=coarse), coarse (ee15184 coarse parts), fine (ee15184 fine parts). Surface tops and wall stand clip depths are read from the named shapes. Counts only. tol: band round the colliders value as lab/test_stands.js gates it (shares) or 1 cm (depths, heights).
anchors_itemstand: identical in all four runs (wall stand anchors are read from the colliders behind the stand)
other_rows: the remaining shares, house shares, inst shares, quartiles of stands and distinct items per house and median heights are the same in all four runs or move inside their tolerance (table in docs/BLUEPRINT_LAB.md, Corpus recount with fine models)
